text_block_list.text:
Sleep for a day, and another day passes. 
Before I knew it, less than a month 
remained until the Prix Foy.

For now, there are no concerns. I have 
completely gotten used to the training 
grounds that took all my effort just to 
adapt to last year.

"All that was left was to devise a 
strategy for the race. Turning on the 
tablet to check the registered Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer <username>! Judging by how flustered you 
are—"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—You saw it too, didn't you? Her 
announcement to enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...The return of Rigantona, the legend 
who conquered the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

...Liganto-na. She's the Umamusume known 
as the strongest in Europe.

"She conquered the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe on her very first attempt, 
pulling off a late surge to beat the 
strongest Umamusume in history while 
setting a course record."

A brilliant figure who had shone in 
numerous other European GⅠ races as well, 
people around the world loudly proclaimed: 
she truly was—the 'world's greatest 
Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"To think she would run in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe once again..."
choice_data_list: Could you help me think of a strategy?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally.

The next day, when I went out to the 
training grounds, that Umamusume was 
surrounded by what looked like a 
multinational crowd of reporters.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Journalist A
text_block_list.text:
"Rigantona! Why enter the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe again?!"

text_block_list.name: Foreign Journalist B
text_block_list.text:
""You spent the entirety of last year 
resting, so does this mean your leg has 
made a full recovery!?""

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: "The finest stage has called upon me."

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: "...To etch myself into memory, you say."

Overwhelming acceleration. On turf where 
hooves sank deep, Rigantona blew past the 
Umamusume running ahead of her, one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Shocking! Just how many seconds was that 
furlong... breakdown!?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...That was just the beginning. For her, 
that was barely a third of what she's 
capable of."
choice_data_list: One third, so then in the real race…

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how far ahead you are, no 
Umamusume can escape her closing speed.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's enough of a "legend" for people to 
say that.

Is this frustration, or vexation? A 
burning ache that threatens to sour my 
chest swirls within my gut.

However, no matter who stands before me, I 
refuse to give up on the dream of being 
the best in the world that I share with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: !? Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ……Oh.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ...It has manifested in you, too.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
Asking question after question, so 
passionate. ...Is my Japanese good?
choice_data_list:
...! Come to think of it, you speak 
Japanese...

...! Come to think of it, you speak 
Japanese...

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
I love Japanese races. And... I love races 
from other countries too.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
...Memorize this body even more. Be 
jealous of it, etch it into your mind.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
—Keep me running, even with that heart of 
yours.

In that instant, the world was left behind 
by her.

The Umamusume who was right in front of my 
eyes a moment ago vanished up ahead in the 
blink of an eye.

That run was far, far faster than the one 
I had just witnessed moments ago.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Astonishing! Trainer <username>, you headed 
straight for Regantona without a moment's 
hesitation, didn't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. That must be what they mean 
when they say your body moves on its own.

On the way home. Chairwoman Akikawa and 
the others spoke to me. However, their 
voices went right in one ear and out the 
other.

—Even now, the only thing burned into my 
mind was the way Rigantona ran.

"On the day of the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, it won't just be Rigantona—Venus 
Park will be in the race as well."

What kind of direction should I give <chrname> 
moving forward? Above all, what strategy 
should we use on race day—
choice_data_list: ...What must we do to defeat them?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You've gained a fantastic perspective 
there!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It seems we have continued to grow even 
after coming here!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Last year, we were so desperate to win the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe that we didn't 
care about our opponent's condition, did 
we?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, she is different this year. She 
is calmly analyzing her opponent and 
preparing a response.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Strength is what grants one composure.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry too much. We also have the 
strength to stand against them. —Believe 
in your own power, in all of your 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mei. Regarding the future training for the 
representative girls—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"We've already discussed it so that each 
person adjusts according to their own 
physical condition."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
With last year behind us, the fruits of a 
year's preparation are showing. You have 
the ability to compete with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: All that's missing now is confidence.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: It's what supports them in the end.
